'''Tosk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Warden/Legends|warden]] who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] before he was killed by spacers hired by the [[Wookiee]]s. He wore a gray set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]<ref name="ROTW" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tosk was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="ROTW" />
